name: media-card
title: Media card
description: A card for a video, a podcast episode or an image: thumbnail, kind badge, duration chip, title and a progress line, as one link or button.
docs: The whole card is one link (pass href) or one button (pass onClick without href), so there is a single tab stop and a single target for a finger. kind is video, audio or image: it sets the icon and the word on the badge (labels={{ audio: 'Podcast' }} says what you show) and the mark in the middle, a play button or a magnifier. thumbnail is decoration (alt is empty) because the title is what is read; without it a calm block stands in. duration is in seconds, drawn bottom right in tabular numbers on a dark chip that holds contrast on any picture, and a screen reader hears it in words. progress from 0 to 1 draws a thin white line in a dark strip along the bottom of the picture, so it reads on a pale picture and on a white page alike, and the card's name then ends with 'Resume at 12:40' (or 'Finished' near the end, when the line is full). Hover only brightens the play mark. aspectRatio is width over height (16 / 9 by default, 1 for cover art): give a grid one ratio and its rows line up. meta is the line under the title, and the title keeps to two lines. labels replaces the words.
